stories.title: A new manufacturing process uses lasers to seal paper packaging instead of glue
stories.summary: Although paper is a more environmentally friendly packaging material than plastic, it's often contaminated with additives, such as adhesives used to create a secure seal. That complicates the recycling process and reduces the quality of recycled paper.
